changes: The room list shows the total floor area of all rooms.
Doors can show the door itself: turn on Show door, set how far open it is (0 to 180 degrees), and flip the hinge side or swing direction.
Remove a single wall of a room: the neighbouring walls extend until they meet, and a small jog straightens out. Doors and windows stay where they are.
Dragging a corner snaps it onto other rooms' corners and walls, and lines it up with nearby corners. Dragging a whole room snaps its corners onto neighbouring rooms.

Import rooms from a Polycam scan: export the scan as GLTF (free plan) and choose the file under Settings, Rooms, Import room scan. Walls, doors and windows from LiDAR room scans come straight in, and plain 3D scans are cut through at two heights to find the walls and separate the rooms.
Removed the iPhone camera-aiming scanner and the HTTPS port (3443) added in 2026.10.4. Android phones with ARCore can still scan with AR from the same dialog.

Room scanning on iPhone: aim the camera at each floor corner and tap. Uses the phone's motion sensors, since iPhones can't do AR in the browser. "Move" keeps rooms lined up, and the phone height can be corrected afterwards.
HAIVE is also served over HTTPS on port 3443 with its own certificate, which iPhones need for camera access. The certificate is limited to local addresses.
The scan dialog has Android and iPhone instructions, and shows an "Open the scanner" button when opened on a phone.
Scan review shows each room's size.
Works on phones in portrait and landscape: compact toolbar, safe-area aware layout and a 3D view that fits tall screens.
Settings become a collapsible bottom sheet on phones, and the 3D view recentres beside or above the open settings.
Room editor: pinch to zoom, two-finger pan and finger-sized corner and wall targets.
Interface size never goes above 100% on phones, so a large wall-panel setting no longer crowds them.
The "Add another screen" address now uses the host's LAN IP when HAIVE is opened via localhost or a .local name (the add-on reads it from the Supervisor).
Two-finger panning in the 3D view, kept within the floorplan and reset by the idle return.
Fix creating rooms, furniture and scans when HAIVE is opened over plain HTTP.
Demo mode now includes a washing machine to show the appliance animation.
Fix add-on failing to start when the image was built from a Windows checkout.
Appliance controls and in-scene appliance effects.
Room scanning page.
Redesigned device controls with shared toggles and sliders.
Lamp lighting, graphics quality setting and shadow updates.
Connection banner, toasts and new settings panels.
Initial HAIVE release — 3D Home Assistant interface for Raspberry Pi touchscreens.
